headline: Cooper Companies (COO) Stock Looks Weak On Returns Yet Rich On Earnings
summary: Cooper Companies' share price has fallen about 33% over the past five years, and with the stock now around US$70.31, the valuation checks currently lean toward the shares looking expensive rather than like a clear bargain. Over the past five years, Cooper Companies has delivered a cumulative shareholder loss of roughly 33%, which raises the bar for the current price to be supported by future earnings and cash flows.
